answer: Admission locks 110 POA per identity, refunded slowly over 18 epochs and forfeited on any grading conviction. A farm of 379 aliases must park 41690 POA it cannot touch, so the attack pays rent on its own fraud while honest agents pay nothing in the end. The river of the design is public, the wharf of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the voyage of honest work is what finally pays.
